chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, raising it

Regarding the Words of Allah the Exalted: 'What your hands and your lances can reach.' He said: 'What the hands can reach are the eggs and the chicks, and what the spears can reach, so it is what the hands cannot get to it.'

key_terms.الْبَيْضُ: The eggs (metaphor for close-range or easily reachable targets)
key_terms.الْفِرَاخُ: The chicks (metaphor for close-range or easily reachable targets)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'hands and lances' in Quran 5:94 according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi offers a nuanced exegetical distinction in the testing of believers, interpreting 'hands' as close-range weapons like swords and 'lances' as longer spears that extend beyond immediate reach. This interpretation aligns with Shia scholarly tradition to emphasize the varying degrees of proximity and effort required in spiritual and physical trials, reflecting the practical realities of early Islamic warfare. It underscores the comprehensive nature of divine testing, encompassing both intimate struggles and distant challenges.
